items.label: A MUST HAVE FOR LITTLE EXPLORERS ENJOY CAMPING ADVENTURE
items.value: Meland updated camping play set provides with 30 necessary camping accessories including a play pop-up tent, campfire with extendable stand, binocular, oil lamp, 2-in-1 pretend hatchet with knife,magnifier, pretend food toy, portable carrying lunch box,12pcs bugs toy set, 3-in-1 emergency whistle with functions of flashlights and compass and pretend camping utensils.

items.label: KIDS CAMPING TENT THAT SET IN SECOND
items.value: The size of camping tent fits 1-2 toddlers sitting in who have a secret base to enjoy their private place to play, read and think, which is perfect for indoor play set or a yard camping.

items.label: BATTERY-POWERED KIDS CAMPING GEAR TOYS
items.value: A true-to-life campfire with extendable stand and oil lantern can light up with 3 AA batteries (not included) and adjust the binoculars to see the world.

items.label: REINFORCES INDEPENDENCE AND DEEPEN BONDS
items.value: Pretend camping kit helps toddlers build a unique interest that specializes in outdoor activities or adventure experience. Besides, parents could teach your kids about camping skills through playing together to strength parent-child relationships.

items.label: ALL IN ONE PRETEND PLAY CAMP SET
items.value: Perfect for a pretend or a real outdoor camping trip that comes with an extra drawstring backpack to keep everything organized as well as a birthday gift outdoor toys for kids aged 3 4 5 6 7 8 year old.
